The portion of the RSS item description that includes a link to the user's profile (for example):

Submitted by <a href='u/UserName3000'>UserName3000</a>

uses a relative instead of an absolute URL, which causes it to be invalid in almost all RSS readers (for example, in my RSS reader, it comes out as https://voat.co/rss/u/UserName3000, on FeedBucket it comes out as http://www.feedbucket.com/u/UserName3000, etc)

Basically if you use a web-based feed reader, the user links come out as relative to the site's URL, and with a feed reader program/app, they come out as relative to https://voat.co/rss/.
Small error in sub RSS feeds - the use of a relative URL for the user's profile breaks the link
